name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. The trailing _3 is the page/mode number (page=3, matching PUSH 0x3 and the 2nd argument of the display call), a meaningful domain value, NOT a Ghidra address residue (the function address 0x34906 bears no relation to the suffix 3). Name accurately reflects purpose (show chapter intro text dialog, fixed page 3).
purpose: Named helper (thunk) that displays data_fd2_current_chapter_text dialog page 3 via fd2_display_dialog_scene using the standard chapter-dialog geometry.
logic_summary: Pure 8-PUSH chain (page=3 plus fixed dialog geometry) then JMP (0x3491F -> 0x34C0F) into the shared tail of fd2_show_chapter_dialog_with_portrait_set_1, which pushes data_fd2_current_chapter_text as the 9th arg, calls fd2_display_dialog_scene, then does the cdecl 0x24-byte cleanup and RET. In source the borrowed tail is reproduced inline as a single call for Layer-2 equivalence: fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text, 3, 0xA0000, 0x140, 0xCD, 0x4C, 0x4A, 0x13, 1). No stack frame, no __CHK probe, EBX untouched.

returns.semantics: No return value; performs a side-effecting dialog render.
